name: Kanou Tenzen
source:
Another boy who lives on the island. Though he looks cool and diligent, he is someone who is very devoted to tennis and has a weird behavior.

He made the secret base in the mountain together with Ryouichi. He brought in a table tennis table and trains hard everyday.
translation:
Another boy who lives on the island. Though he looks cool and diligent, he is someone who is very devoted to tennis and has a weird behavior.

He made the secret base in the mountain together with Ryouichi. He brought in a table tennis table and trains hard everyday.
